notes           →  notes  (leaf)
create_note     →  note:create
update_note     →  note:update
close_notes     →  note:close
complete_notes  →  note:complete
reopen_notes    →  note:reopen
search_notes    →  note:search
secrets         →  secrets  (leaf)
set_secret      →  secret:set
delete_secrets  →  secret:delete
builds          →  builds  (leaf)
run_builds      →  build:run
confirm_builds  →  build:confirm
